cases.name: Sara Michelle Stoffle
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Although her life was short-lived, everyone who knew Sarah will tell you that it was well-lived. Sarah had a desire to get everything she could out of life. She would never turn down an opportunity to do something fun. Sarah had a huge heart, loved so many, and was loved by so many more. Not only did she have so much love for her friends and family, but so much love for her animals. She was always caught smuggling her turtle along with her everywhere she went, and gave unconditional love and attention to her cat Kai, and dogs Roshi and Shuro.

Sarah’s bold and adventurous personality will be with us always. She was always very independent and headstrong, when she had her mind set on something she would always make it happen, whether that be graduating early, getting a new job, or any goal she set her mind to.  We will think of Sarah everyday, and reminisce on the countless memories we have. Every time we see a hoodie, a messy bun, sweatpants or pajama pants we will think of Sarah. Every time we order a McDonald’s hash brown, breakfast tacos, shrimp, or chicken and waffles, we will think of Sarah. We will be reminded of her by random everyday things. Seeing something that instantly brings up a memory of Sarah will become a consistent blessing.

Words cannot describe how much we miss Sarah. Every day will feel unjust to wake up in the morning knowing Sarah is unable to wake up with us. We will miss her forever, but Sarah hated seeing her loved ones in pain and we know she would want us to choose to be joyful and celebrate her life, rather than mourn her death. What no one will ever know is the total number of lives Sarah touched. Who knows how many people she helped out of a rough spot with her generosity and selflessness, how many smiles she evoked with her audacious charm, or how many bursts of laughter were caused by her goofy nature. There’s no way to count or retrace that, but we do know that the number is large. We will forever be grateful for Sarah, and cherish the many memories we have."
cases.narrative: On 3/25/2020, her body was found in a shed. He had shot her in the chest at close range.
